name: volunteerist
description: Volunteerist - Google Apps Script volunteer follow-up tracker. Sample: copy the Spreadsheet, run Set Up, connect volunteers to Asks.

scripts.build:validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const code=fs.readFileSync('dist/Code.js','utf8');if(/^(export|import)\s/m.test(code)){console.error('ERROR: ES module syntax found in dist/Code.js');process.exit(1)}console.log('Build validation passed')"
scripts.push: npm run build && npm run build:validate && clasp push -f
scripts.check:commit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run check:commit && npm run test
